culprit_citations.quoted_text: Air Transport Components Acquisition, LLC | fair value 6,983 | 0.2% of net assets

findings.detail: The identity check is tighter than the filing's one-decimal percentage disclosure, causing valid rounded percentages to fail.

rationale: Class 3 anchor triangulation shows the schedule total is internally consistent after source rounding: 5,804,557 / 2,783,366 * 100 = 208.543%, which the filing prints as 208.5%. The source explicitly reports percent of net assets to only one decimal for both total and position rows. Therefore a tight exact identity can legitimately fail many rows (the flagged 46.27%) without any extracted value being wrong. The defect is the check's precision/scope, not the filing data.
